name: PROJECT APEX
desc:
Participating in an experimental program that intends to push the boundaries of human capabilities through genetic manipulation and bioengineering, you and up to three other players will take on a mission-driven campaign that covers the history of the TITAN Corporation up until the global freeze, all experienced through the view of a helmet camera.

Weekends provide double income and XP.

Thumbnails made by Nik5715

⚠ WORK IN PROGRESS
This game is in demo. Tutorial, more missions, outbreak expansions, character model reworks, etc. will come in time. If you encounter any issues, please report them to us.

⦾ HARDWARE
Mid-ranged hardware is required to play this game at minimum performance. We try to balance our visual fidelity with high performance, however, there is a limit to our strategies.
